title: Fredrico
wikitext:
{{NPC Infobox |image = NPC Fredrico.png |type = Open-World |nation = Rinascita |location = Sanguis Plateaus |location2 = Tetragon Temple (Area) |affiliation = Septimont |affiliationNote = Gladiator |group = Gladiator |father = Goffredo }} __NOTOC__ '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a fledgling male Gladiator participating in the Hunt for the first time. He is seen with the Blacksmith, [[Baptiste]].
His father is '''Goffredo''', makes an exclusive appearance in the Ephor's Palace during {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}. {{Dialogue Start}} ==Dialogue== :'''Baptiste''': This is the best blade I've forged in a long while. :'''Baptiste''': To face the Dark Tide creations, steel and soul must fight as one. Sadly, I've seen far more blades make it home than men... :'''Baptiste''': Hope this blade bring you luck, lad! :'''Fredrico''': Does this sword have a name, sir? :'''Baptiste''': No, not yet. Tell me, lad, what's your name? :'''Fredrico''': Fredrico, sir. :'''Baptiste''': Fredrico... A fine name. Return with this blade, and you can name it after you. :'''Fredrico''': ...I will earn that honor, sir. :'''Fredrico''': For the glory of my House, I'll prove myself worthy of this sword. ---- ;(Afterward [[By Sun's Burning Hand]]) :'''Baptiste''': You made it back, lad! :'''Fredrico''': Barely... This hunt was beyond anything I imagined. Just staying alive took all I had. If it weren't for Ephor Augusta and the others... :'''Baptiste''': Survival is an honor in itself. Don't be too hard on yourself. :'''Fredrico''': Also... the sword you gave me, I lost it in the battle... :'''Fredrico''': A Gladiator should never let go of their blade. I guess I'm not ready yet... :'''Baptiste''': Haha! A sword's a sword. I can always forge another. :'''Baptiste''': But you, you are the real blade of Septimont. This hunt only whets your edge. :'''Baptiste''': Shame, though. The sword with your name will have to wait for another day. :'''Fredrico''' Until then, I'll keep sharpening myself. {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Fredrico |zhs = 费德里科 |zht = 費德里科 |ja = フェデリコ |ko = 프레데리코 |fr = Fredrico |de = Fredrico |es = Fredrico |th = เฟรดริโก }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.6}}
